The landlords accepted cash, so J took the $3000 that was meant for rent and spent it on bills that her sister isn't even sure about. This ruined J's relationship with her roommates. Her uncle was supposed to pick her up, and she was going to move out of state. But J never asked her uncle to come together and mentioned to L that she might just stay in New York. She comes home to sleep after partying with her friends. Our house has become a hangover den. What makes it worse is the current situation: the job J had a chance at has shut down, so she's not even looking for work. But that's not stopping her from going out every other night to parties, where she doesn't even think about the risk of getting sick from being irresponsible, which would affect us as well.
